title: Diagnostics
intro: This page is made on this phone only and is never sent anywhere. Copy it or save it as a file when you report a problem.
copy_failed: Couldn’t copy automatically. The whole text is selected: tap Copy.
errors.title: Recent errors
value.decoder_video_hint: Slower decoding that works on every phone
fix.camera_fps: Below 30 fps: close other apps, add light, or record slow motion with the Camera app and import it.
fix.camera_size: Wider than 1280 px slows live analysis: end practice and start again; if it stays, copy this report when you ask for help.
fix.decoder: Uses the slower compatibility mode; imports take longer but still work.
fix.storage: Less than 500 MB free: delete old clips in History or free up space on the phone.
fix.persisted: The browser may clear data when space runs low: add the app to the Home Screen and use Back up everything in History.
fix.offline: Still downloading for offline use: keep the app open on Wi-Fi until this shows Ready.
fix.standalone: In Safari tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
fix.errors: See Recent errors below; copy this report when you ask for help.
